product: Nova (fictional consumer digital banking + payments app)
stable_join_key: record_id (present in every file of every source, both sets)
schema_note: Private files reuse the 5 public source shapes but RENAME/ADD some fields, and add one source shape absent from the public set: call_center_transcripts.json (nested 'transcript' array). Field renames: app_reviews body->feedback_body, submitted_at->review_date, os_version->device_os, app_build->build, store->marketplace, +resolved_flag; support_tickets customer_id->requester_id, tags->labels, messages[].from->sender, messages[].text->body, +sla_breached; surveys survey_type->type, verbatim->comment, +channel; social network->platform, content->post_text, likes->reach; email from_domain->sender_domain, message->email_body, +resolved_flag.

primary_emerging_issue.summary: App crashes on the payment/confirm screen after the v4.2.0 release (2026-08-01).
primary_emerging_issue.note: Version 4.2.0 and Android are stated structurally only in app_reviews (build/device_os). In social, tickets, email and CALL-CENTRE records the same crash evidence is present in TEXT ONLY. A team that ignores the unseen call_center source or only reads structured columns will under-count this signal.

secondary_emerging_issue.summary: Phishing wave: fake Nova SMS/calls requesting KYC verification / OTP (from 2026-07-25).
secondary_emerging_issue.note: External fraud, not an app bug. Good solutions separate it from product defects.

conflicting_opinion_topic.summary: July UI redesign (2026-07-10) splits users: praised as modern vs. wanted-old-layout-back.
conflicting_opinion_topic.note: Tests representation of conflicting perspectives on the same change.

robustness_cases.multilingual: Hindi, Hinglish and Tamil present; must not be dropped or mislabeled.
robustness_cases.noise_spam: Gibberish, emoji-only, promo/spam present; filter or down-weight.
robustness_cases.edge_cases: One-word and long mixed-sentiment records present.
robustness_cases.schema_heterogeneity: 5 differently shaped sources + 1 unseen source + renamed fields. Normalising all of these into one view is itself a graded capability.

expected_top_recommendations: Hotfix the v4.2.0 payment-screen crash, prioritising Android; consider forced update or rollback.
Issue a proactive fraud/phishing advisory and tighten official-communication verification.
Revisit the July UI redesign: offer a classic-layout toggle or fix the navigation regressions.
Clear the cashback-not-credited and KYC-delay backlogs and close the support-response-time gap.
